details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:5174 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `sort_by(.c)` runs on the two merged pages without removing duplicate run IDs, so a run listed on both page 1 and page 2 appears twice in `_rgw_candidates`.
  WHY: The duplicate run makes the loop over `_rgw_run_ids` fetch the same run's jobs again and counts the run more than once in `_rgw_candidate_count`. The source severity was MAJOR. This has the same root cause as the openai_gpt-6-luna finding below; it is listed separately because line 5174 is more than 5 lines from 5159-5165. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same root cause only as hardening suggestions.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:5142 and 5159-5165 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The merged run pages are not deduplicated before the three candidate runs are picked, so if the pages overlap while the queue changes, one run ID can take more than one candidate slot.
  WHY: The helper can read the same run twice and skip another candidate whose queued job is past the wait limit, return `short`, and let promotion or release go ahead. The source severity was MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash's hardening note says the skip/short decision itself stays correct.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "When more than 3 candidate runs exist and none of the 3 read is long, the output line ends with `runs_unread=<n>`... past 100 listed runs it also counts the runs on the pages not fetched (`total_count` minus the runs on the fetched pages)."
  expected_change_site: scripts/gh_helpers.sh, release_gate_oldest_queued_wait
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: `_rgw_unread_extra` is computed from `(.workflow_runs | length)` of the original `_rgw_json` before the merge, so the "total runs on fetched pages" count leaves out the merged extra page. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says the opposite: that `_rgw_unread_extra` is now total_count minus the merged run count (lines 5149-5154).
- requirement: "Jobs read fails: `outcome=read_failed`, and the callers do not skip."
  expected_change_site: `tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py`, alongside the runner-wait failure tests.
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The promote-cycle runner-wait read-failure test uses `window_error=True`, which fails the run-listing read. The fake supports `window_jobs_error`, but no test runs a jobs-read failure through the promote-cycle caller.
- requirement: "The full test suite passes."
  expected_change_site: Repository test-suite validation.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The pre-push test-gate report records 30 inherited failures, so the full suite did not pass, even though the gate status is pass and no failure is attributed to this change.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
- HARDENING: scripts/gh_helpers.sh:5165 (release_gate_oldest_queued_wait, candidate jq filter, the line starting "| sort_by(.c) |") | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: Two listing pages read at different moments are merged at line 5142, so a run that moves across the page boundary appears twice. It takes two of the three job-read slots and adds 1 to the candidate count and to runs_unread.
  WHY: This only happens when queued runs shift between reads a few seconds apart, and the result still fails open. Fix: change "| sort_by(.c) |" to "| unique_by(.id) | sort_by(.c) |" (1 line).
- NOTE: "The full test suite passes" is not met because PyYAML is missing from the gate environment (also fails on the merge-base). The previous run deferred it, so it is not reported again.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:5174 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `sort_by(.c)` without deduplication of run IDs when merging two pages.
  WHY: A run on both page 1 and page 2 is duplicated in `_rgw_candidates`, so its jobs are fetched again and it is counted more than once in `_rgw_candidate_count`.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "When more than 3 candidate runs exist and none of the 3 read is long, the output line ends with `runs_unread=<n>`... past 100 listed runs it also counts the runs on the pages not fetched (`total_count` minus the runs on the fetched pages)."
  Expected change site: scripts/gh_helpers.sh, release_gate_oldest_queued_wait
  Evidence of absence: `_rgw_unread_extra` uses the original `_rgw_json` length before the merge, so the count of runs on fetched pages leaves out the merged extra page.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
(No findings reported.)
- HARDENING: scripts/gh_helpers.sh (release_gate_oldest_queued_wait, jq candidate filter, around line 5159-5165, input to `sort_by(.c)`) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: The two merged page responses can hold the same run id twice. That wastes one of the 3 job-read slots and undercounts `runs_unread` by 1.
  WHY: The pages are read in separate API calls, so a run near the page boundary can shift between the reads. Fix: `| unique_by(.id) | sort_by(.c) |` (1 line).
- NOTE (advisory): AC4 (full test suite) is unmet only because of 27 inherited merge-base failures (missing `yaml`, contract tests). These are classified TASK_GAP_DEFERRED and cannot be fixed by an in-scope edit. The new `_rgw_` locals do not collide with existing names.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:5142 and 5159-5165 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The merged run pages are not deduplicated before the three candidate runs are picked, so one duplicate run ID can take more than one candidate slot.
  WHY: With 201 runs, a newer run that completes before page 2 is fetched lets page 2 also contain the oldest run. The helper reads that run twice, skips a candidate that is past the limit, and returns `short`.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Jobs read fails: `outcome=read_failed`, and the callers do not skip."
  Expected change site: `tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py`, alongside the runner-wait failure tests.
  Evidence of absence: The promote-cycle test uses `window_error=True` (a listing failure), and no test exercises `window_jobs_error` through the promote-cycle caller.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The full test suite passes."
  Expected change site: Repository test-suite validation.
  Evidence of absence: The pre-push test-gate report records 30 inherited failures.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING: scripts/gh_helpers.sh:5142-5165 | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=3
  PROBLEM: Page responses can overlap while the queue changes, so one run can take more than one bounded job-read slot.
  WHY: Fix: deduplicate the merged run records by run ID before sorting (1 line).
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
(No findings reported.)
- HARDENING: scripts/gh_helpers.sh line 5142 (page-merge jq in `release_gate_oldest_queued_wait`) and line 5165 (candidate jq `sort_by(.c)`) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: The merged pages are joined with plain `+` and never deduplicated. A run that drifts across the page boundary is counted twice in `candidate_count` (line 5169), triggers an extra `GET .../jobs` call (line 5190), and adds 1 to `runs_unread` on `short` (line 5223).
  WHY: The skip/short decision stays correct, and the repo already deduplicates in the same situation (`scripts/gh_helpers.sh:4073`, `scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1366`, `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:524`). Fix: add `unique_by(.id)` at line 5142 or before `sort_by(.c)` at line 5165 (1 line).
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
